delta.caption: Stored paired isotropic delta (fourbar − gearbox); only regular finite eligible pairs are shown. Unavailable pairs remain blank and their exclusion reasons are available in the cell inspector.

identity_scalar.caption: Identity-on-shared-Q reference uses its own full finite range [0.500326, 0.596757], with no clipped values. Compare numeric values using the inspector; this scale differs from the primary paired scale.

polygons.caption: Shape-normalized polygon glyphs only. Glyph size is not force magnitude.

positive_x.caption: Primary directional ray capacity (positive_x) on regular-finite cells only, with shared colour limits from those values. Undefined/unbounded and near-singular cells are masked here.

positive_x_diagnostic.caption: Diagnostic view for positive_x: all finite ray capacities including near-singular cells. Scale may be dominated by ill-conditioned outliers; use the primary figure for comparison.

ratio.caption: Stored paired isotropic ratio (fourbar / gearbox); only regular finite eligible pairs are shown. Unavailable pairs remain blank and their exclusion reasons are available in the cell inspector.

scalar.caption: Primary view: isotropic radius on the retained mounted-Q grid (axes show grid indices; cell JSON stores exact Q). Paired colour limits [0.685736, 3.79347]. Force units: normalized_torque_per_length.

status.caption: Categorical stored whole-set status for all three arms. A set can be unbounded while some directional capacities remain finite; inspect their separate field statuses below. Blank cells were not sampled.
